subjects.displayTitle: Love as fire: warmth, illumination, and transformation
subjects.introduction: To one of His correspondents who was burning with the love of God, ‘Abdu’l-Bahá wrote that the blaze, however scorching, is in truth a rose garden and a spring of living water. Fire is the Writings’ favourite figure for love because it refuses to stay in one category. Bahá’u’lláh describes a flame that burns without fuel or smoke, drawing off the damp and cold that leave a soul torpid and setting it in motion toward the Friend; the same heat consumes veils and corrupt desire, welds separate hearts into one, and keeps a weary hand writing to distant friends long after sunset. It also hurts. Longing, separation and grief belong to this element as surely as warmth does, which is why patience and forbearance are counselled in the same breath as ardour. The Song of Songs knows the same vehement flame that many waters cannot quench, in the voice of human lovers [1]. The questions the image presses are practical: what in me is being consumed, what is being lit, and whom will the warmth reach? Those questions lead on toward fire and light, toward the pain of love, toward spiritual transformation, and toward the enkindled state in which a bright face teaches more than words.
subjects.arc: Begin with fire that gives life, follow purification and awakened energy into service and unity, then read longing and endurance before returning to prayer and illumination.

order.why: Read the reported burning of veils through healing, consolation, and virtue.
shortened: By the fire of the Love of God the veil is burnt which separates us from the Heavenly Realities, and with clear vision we are enabled to struggle onward and upward, ever progressing in the paths of virtue and holiness, and becoming the means of light to the world.

There is nothing greater or more blessed than the Love of God! It gives healing to the sick, balm to the wounded, joy and consolation to the whole world, and through it alone can man attain Life Everlasting. The essence of all religions is the Love of God, and it is the foundation of all the sacred teachings.

order.why: Open with the paradox of a scorching fire that is a rose garden and living water.
Read the source’s explicit explanation of outward fire and inward light.
Consider love’s fire as the reality of light.
shortened: Blessed is the soul that hath been illumined and set aglow with the fire of divine love. This fire hath ever been and shall ever remain the reality of light.

order.why: Uses Moses and the flame of Sinai to express the fire of divine love.
Keep patience, composure, and forbearance close to the consuming flame.
Follow the fire’s heat from lethargy toward motion and approach.
shortened: This divine Fire burneth of itself, with neither fuel nor fume, that it might draw away such excess moisture and cold as are the cause of torpor and weariness, of lethargy and despondency, and lead the entire creation to the court of the presence of the All-Merciful. Whoso hath approached this Fire hath been set aflame and attained the desired goal, and whoso hath removed himself therefrom hath remained deprived.

order.why: Read attraction changing coldness into warmth.
shortened: Among these is attraction, and among these is enkindlement and combustion with the fire of the love of God. Thereby lethargy is transformed into warmth, and coldness into the flame of the fire of oneness.

order.why: Consider the burning of veils and dispelling of imagined mist.
Make corrupt desire and renewed remembrance the object of purification.
shortened: Ignite, then, O my God, within my breast the fire of Thy love, that its flame may burn up all else except my remembrance of Thee, that every trace of corrupt desire may be entirely mortified within me, and that naught may remain except the glorification of Thy transcendent and all-glorious Being.

order.why: Read the concise counsel to burn away desires.
shortened: O servant! Burn away desires with the fire of the love of thy Lord, the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted.

order.why: Consider the prayer for sincere hearts to hold to the divine will.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Illuminator of the world and He Who hath appeared through the Most Great Name, to cause the hearts of those who are sincere toward Thee to be set ablaze with the heat of Thy love, that they may cast aside their desires and hold fast unto that which Thou hast willed through Thy command.

order.why: Read the extended prayer for the effects of love in heart, land, and conduct.
Keep the consuming fire in its devotional language of attachment to God.
shortened: It is the divine fire which, when kindled in the breasts, consumeth all things besides God. The hearts of the lovers are aflame with this fire.

order.why: Read the account of veils already burned away.
Keep the parallel acknowledgment in its own prayerful voice.
Read the varied images of recognition and severance from idols and self.
shortened: Then by My power break the seal of the vessel of My musk that perchance they may find and know and understand, then learn and remember, then perceive and attain and behold this dawning Dayspring and this gleaming Moon and this rising Star and this rain-laden Cloud and this surging Ocean and this upraised Heaven and this exalted House and this manifest Grace and this hidden Mystery and this mentioned Symbol. Perchance they may shatter and rend asunder and burn and cut themselves off from and flee their idols, their veils, their glory, away from all save their Lord, away from their own selves.

order.why: Consider the letter’s forceful contrast of destructive impulse and the love of God.
shortened: Although in the world of existence the Outpourings of the Almighty are infinite yet the Greatest Divine Outpouring is the "Love of God." This is the dominant, transcendental Power which rises above all the natural susceptibilities of the world of humanity.
Therefore, man cannot win victory over these physical emotions save through the "Power of the Love of God."

The Fire of the Love of God is like unto the lightening which strikes upon the head of nature, emasculating it of its virility and leaving it fallen on the ground - a lifeless corpse. Consequently the greatest Power in the World of existence is the "Love of God"...

order.why: Read the reported relation of love to human progress.
shortened: If love did not exist, what of reality would remain? It is the fire of the love of God which renders man superior to the animal. Strengthen this superior force through which is attained all the progress in the world.

order.why: Keep the reported fire of sanctity and detachment attributed.
shortened: Were it not for the Fire of the Love of God, how could the life of man become a flame of sanctity and severance?

order.why: Read the explicit distinction between physical fire and love’s penetrating influence.
Consider a flame whose warmth and radiance reach beyond physical distance.
shortened: O living flame of heavenly love! Thine heart hath been so fired with the love of God that from ten thousand leagues afar its warmth and radiance may be felt and seen. The fire lit by mortal hand imparteth light and warmth to but a little space, whereas that sacred flame which the Hand of God hath kindled, though burning in the east, will set aflame the west and give warmth to both the north and the south; nay, it shall rise from this world to glow with the hottest flame in the realms on high, flooding with light the Kingdom of eternal glory.

order.why: Read the prayer that merges companions into one breath and voice.
Consider the reported heated-iron image of unity.
shortened: Or like two pieces of iron: they are dark and cold but, when heated in the fire of love, they become so hot that when they touch each other they unite into one piece and are so bright you cannot tell the iron from the fire. They are one in it.

order.why: See love at work in a weary hand continuing to write to friends.
shortened: O thou who art enkindled with the fire that illumineth the world! It is near sunset and the sun is setting. The place is not well-lit, and this servant is weary in hand and eye, nay in all limbs, from excessive writing. Nevertheless, from the fire of love for the friends of God, the heart is so aflame and the spirit so joyous that it will not let the fingers of the pen rest, and waves of longing surge from the ocean of the heart onto the shores of these pages. O how I long for you, O friends of God!

order.why: Read the yearning for meeting in the morning remembrance of friends.
Keep the absent friend remembered within an enkindled gathering.
Read the paradox of a burning heart whose thirst remains.
Consider longing described as bounty and illumination.
shortened: O my loving friends! The fire of your longing is so intensely ablaze that its heat has affected the horizons and its ardor has influenced the hearts of those dwelling near the Holy Shrine. This is not mere flame - it is bounty. This is not mere heat - it is love. This is not mere longing - it is illumination.

order.why: Bring life’s brevity into the call to service and sacrifice.
shortened: Soon will our handful of days, our vanishing life, be gone, and we shall pass, empty-handed, into the hollow that is dug for those who speak no more; wherefore must we bind our hearts to the manifest Beauty, and cling to the lifeline that faileth never. We must gird ourselves for service, kindle love's flame, and burn away in its heat. We must loose our tongues till we set the wide world's heart afire, and with bright rays of guidance blot out the armies of the night, and then, for His sake, on the field of sacrifice, fling down our lives.

order.why: Read teaching joined to a bright face.
shortened: Loose thy tongue and teach, and let thy face be bright with the fire of God's love.

order.why: Keep the reported living torch joined to universal ideals and second birth.
shortened: Whosoever I send to America must at first gain the regenerative power of the second birth, be baptized with the water of universal ideals and be a living torch of the Fire of the Love of God.

order.why: Read the reported Covenant as an ark moved by love.
Consider the candle’s burning through light offered to a region.
shortened: Day and night kindle the fire of love and like a candle with tearful eyes burn in the fire of the love of God, until from your kindling and burning, lights may shine forth upon those regions and the banner of the Covenant may wave over those horizons.

order.why: Read song as a means of warming and softening hearts.
Keep the brief call to a heart-burning sigh in its figurative setting.
shortened: Take the path of the lovers and run in pursuit of the yearning ones. Heave a heart-burning sigh and set that realm ablaze with the fire of the love of God.

order.why: Read the handmaiden’s candle and fragrant burning as images of illumination.
Consider the prayer for a place to become a center of merciful events.
Read the hope of light reaching surrounding communities.
Consider utterance that melts hearts and awakens attraction.
Read the invitation to a shared sigh and enkindled souls.
Keep fire, flowing water, and fruit together as transformed images.
Read widening knowledge and a brighter fire together.
Consider love’s increasing flame and the source’s account of the friends after bereavement.
shortened: For when the lamp of the love of God is lit in a heart, its flame grows day by day until it becomes entirely a piece of fire. In the Qur'an it states: "That those who believe may increase in their faith." When the Bab and Baha'u'llah ascended, the friends of God in Iran blazed a hundred times more brightly and manifested the utmost sanctity and holiness.

order.why: Read the forge and bellows as an image of assistance in transformation.
shortened: The forge, though filled with fire, yet needs the bellows in order to heat silver and gold, so that solid metal may become liquefied and glow.

order.why: Keep the condition that metaphors must correspond to reality.
Read wisdom as fuel and surrender as the prayer’s goal.
shortened: I implore Thee, O Thou Who causest the dawn to appear, by Thy Lamp which Thou didst light with the fire of Thy love before all that are in heaven and on earth, and whose flame Thou feedest with the fuel of Thy wisdom in the kingdom of Thy creation, to make me to be of those who have soared in Thine atmosphere, and surrendered their will to Thy decree.

order.why: Consider the lamp ignited in the tree of mercy.
shortened: This is a lamp lighted by the fire of Thy love and ablaze with the flame which is ignited in the tree of Thy mercy.

order.why: Read hearts aflame and faces illumined in a prayerful account of nearness.
shortened: Thou art He the fire of Whose love hath set ablaze the hearts of them who have recognized Thy unity, and the splendors of Whose countenance have illuminated the faces of such as have drawn nigh unto Thy court.

order.why: Read the surging sea and blazing fire as paired images of bounty.
Follow the gathering of fire, sea, cloud, breeze, and garden images.
Consider one melody appearing as life-giving water and attracting fire.
Read the fiery thread becoming breeze and melody in the Tablet of the Hair.
shortened: Glorified be God for this fiery thread and this divine cord! At times I behold it as fire, for by it are consumed the hearts of the sincere. At times I behold it as breezes, for by it are stirred the hearts of the believers. And at times there issueth from it a sound like unto melodies that draw unto them the hearts of the lovers.

order.why: Keep the delicate cup, wine, and light as intersecting mystical images.
Consider the comparison between elemental predominance and spiritual attraction.
Retain the reported explanation of elemental fire as a poetic claim.
shortened: The candle is aflame and the heart in melting anguish. None knoweth what is the cause of this, and what its reason. Some maintain that the source and essence of elemental fire is the warmth in the hearts of lovers and the sighs of yearning souls.

order.why: Read the Valley of Love’s radical language of reason, nothingness, and burning.
shortened: 14 And if, by the help of the Creator, he findeth on this journey a trace of the traceless Friend, and inhaleth the fragrance of the long-lost Joseph from the heavenly herald, he shall straightway step into the VALLEY OF LOVE and be consumed in the fire of love. In this city the heaven of rapture is upraised, and the world-illuming sun of yearning shineth, and the fire of love is set ablaze; and when the fire of love is ablaze, it burneth to ashes the harvest of reason.
Be as naught, if thou wouldst kindle the fire of being and be fit for the pathway of love.

order.why: Keep the Layli and Majnun allusion as poetry about longing.
Read the related brief image of Layli’s love.
shortened: The vicissitudes of time, which have appeared through God's irrevocable decrees, have separated companions who shared the same nest, and what beloved ones have been separated from their Beloved, and what lovers have been consumed in separation from their Loved One! The fire of love for Layli blazed forth and effaced from existence the maddened and infatuated souls.

order.why: Hear the verse about love that cannot remain hidden.
Consider the account of sighs, tears, and imagined beloveds.
Keep the language of wandering and infamy in its ecstatic register.
Read the spiritual friend’s call to absorption in the Loving Friend.
Consider the urgent language of longing and sacrifice in its personal address.
Read the call to set the heart alight in the present hour.
shortened: Now is the time to kindle the flame and be consumed by the fire which rageth in the world; now is the hour to set thy heart alight therewith.

order.why: Keep the concise imperative of enkindlement.
Read the two servants addressed through the moth and candle image.
Consider the moths’ fear of none except God.
shortened: The moths of the flower-garden of the Merciful circled round that Incandescent Lamp, and they feared no one save God.

order.why: Keep thirst, living water, burning wings, and good life within the same passage.
shortened: Quench the thirst of those who are parched in the desert of longing with the living waters in this exalted Paradise, and cause the moths of love and affection to circle round the brilliant lamp and burn their wings in the heat of its luminous flame, that they may become the manifestation of 'We shall surely give them a good life' and the dawning-place of 'Nay, they are alive and are provided sustenance from their Lord.'

order.why: Read the prayer’s moth and salamander images as devotional metaphors.
shortened: It is my prayer that thou mayest become a moth that burns its wings in the flaming candle of the love of God, a salamander of love and desire in the fiery path of God.

order.why: Retain the brief depiction of kindled flames and moths.
shortened: O my loving friends! Jinab-i-Za'ir Aqa Nasru'llah has astonished his listeners with his praises and tributes about you, and brought joy and delight to the friends, for those assured souls are verses of unity and manifestations of the grace of detachment. From the intensity of love they are like kindled flames and burnt moths.

order.why: Keep the intense image of the horizons melting in its poetic voice.
shortened: When this bounty appears, the fire of the love of God will blaze forth in such wise as to melt the very liver of the horizons.

order.why: Read the prayer’s inner fire heard throughout the veins.
shortened: The fire of Thy love that burneth continually within me hath so inflamed me that whoever among Thy creatures approacheth me, and inclineth his inner ear towards me, cannot fail to hear its raging within each of my veins.

order.why: Consider the limbs as witnesses to the mysterious fire.
shortened: How mysterious the Fire which Thou hast enkindled within my heart! My very limbs testify to the intensity of its heat, and evince the consuming power of its flame.

order.why: Read the response to the divine call throughout the whole person.
shortened: For Thy call hath seized me and Thy voice hath kindled such fire in all my limbs that should anyone examine my entire frame, they would find no place therein save that which burneth with the flame of Thy love and the fire of Thy affection.

order.why: Hear the brief prayer concerning a weak body and burning love.
Keep the concise reported account of the source of enkindlement.
shortened: My enkindlement is obtained from the Fire of the Love of God.

order.why: Retain the particular letter’s report of eagerness and love.
Read the testimony of tongues and pens to a handmaiden’s attraction.
Keep the greeting to the enkindled addressee.
Consider the hope of love awakening in youth.
shortened: O Isma'il! God willing, mayest thou be favored by divine grace and be enkindled in thy youth with the fire of the love of God.

order.why: Read remembrance by day and night as sustained practice.
Keep love, fasting, praise, and remembrance together in the Naw-Ruz prayer.
shortened: Grant, O my Lord, that the fire of Thy love and the heat produced by the fast enjoined by Thee may inflame them in Thy Cause, and make them to be occupied with Thy praise and with remembrance of Thee.

order.why: Read the Long Obligatory Prayer’s invocation within its supplied instruction.
shortened: Let him again raise his hands in supplication, and say:
O Thou in separation from Whom hearts and souls have melted, and by the fire of Whose love the whole world hath been set aflame!

order.why: Hear the call to sustained burning and lamentation.
Consider the restlessness of separation.
Read the paradox of separation’s fire as a desired bounty.
Keep the tension between union, separation, and fear of losing union.
shortened: In this hour when the bride of love hath emerged from behind the veil, and the fire of separation hath blazed forth from heart and soul, and cast patience from its throne, as the countenance of the Friend hath been unveiled - we are in separation, yet wagering our lives in hope of union, though even in union there is fear of separation.

order.why: Read the brief grief of separation after communion.
Consider lamentation communicated among friends.
shortened: O thou who gazest toward the holy sanctuary of the Lord!
The heart-burning lament which thou didst raise from the world-consuming fire of love melted the hearts of the friends of God and raised the banner of sorrows upon the standards of hearts.

order.why: Keep the prose becoming verse and the explicit movement from joy to grief.
Read the extended interwoven images moving through sorrow toward renewed life.
Consider the searching question about drawing near to a consuming love.
shortened: None can love Me save those who are brought nigh, for My love is a fire that consumeth the hearts - how then can any draw near unto it?

order.why: Read love continuing amid imprisonment, darkness, and closed opportunities for comfort.
shortened: Though -- as Thou beholdest me, O my God -- I be dwelling in a place within whose walls no voice can be heard except the sound of the echo, though all the gates of ease and comfort be shut against us, and thick darkness appear to have compassed us on every side, yet my soul hath been so inflamed by its love for Thee, that nothing whatsoever can either quench the fire of its love or abate the consuming flame of its desire.

order.why: Consider hardship unable to extinguish the fire.
shortened: I know not what fire Thou hast kindled within me by the hands of Thy power, such that the waters of hardship in Thy love cannot extinguish it, nor can the seas of trials in Thy remembrance and praise.

order.why: Read the undying fire that the waters of the universe cannot cool.
shortened: Let thy soul glow with the flame of this undying Fire that burneth in the midmost heart of the world, in such wise that the waters of the universe shall be powerless to cool down its ardor.

order.why: Keep the prayer’s wonder before unquenchable radiance.
shortened: I know not, O my God, what the Fire is which Thou didst kindle in Thy land. Earth can never cloud its splendor, nor water quench its flame.

order.why: Consider the paradox of water transformed into fuel.
Read the flame that remains when other fires cease.
shortened: The restlessness of every sea hath been stilled, but not the restlessness of this Ocean which moveth at the bidding of the winds of Thy will. The flame of every fire hath been extinguished except the Flame which the hands of Thine omnipotence have kindled, and whose radiance Thou hast, by the power of Thy name, shed abroad before all that are in Thy heaven and all that are on Thy earth.

order.why: Keep the historical account of persecution and an inward flame beneath outward quiet.
shortened: Although in truth the people of that land did not fall short and sacrificed their lives, and due to the intensity of afflictions and abundance of calamities and increasing martyrdoms in the early days of the Cause, outwardly there came about some quiet and silence, yet in secret the fire of love is blazing intensely. God willing, may this flame become world-consuming and this radiance become world-illumining.

order.why: Read the source’s relation of love to the suffering of the Bab, Christ, and Husayn.
shortened: This is the fire of the love of God that made the Exalted One - may my spirit be offered up for Him - the target of a thousand bullets. This is the fire of the love of God that made the sweet Christ the adornment of the cross. This is the fire of the love of God that made the Prince of Martyrs the martyr of the plain of Karbila.

order.why: Retain the particular remembrance of martyrdom.
shortened: Verily he attained unto the lights of the Countenance and was set ablaze by the fire of the love of God to such degree that he was martyred in His path.

order.why: Keep the brief relation of divine will, life, and fire in its source’s context.
Read guidance, oneness, and the enkindled heart.
shortened: O My dearly loved friend! When the light of the Morn of Divine guidance flasheth and glisteneth from the horizon of truth, the radiant heart of man partaketh of it through the Divine light, the lamp of His bounty beameth forth and sheddeth the light of Oneness, the fire of love is kindled and consumeth the souls of men.

order.why: Consider the Sinai image as a call to illumination in all conditions.
Keep the imagined breath and consumed letter in its figurative setting.
Read joy, fragrance, and fervor as an invitation toward the divine world.
shortened: Thus mayest thou attain an eternal countenance and behold an everlasting beauty, seek the joy and gladness of the divine world, inhale the holy fragrances of the Abha Kingdom, breathe in the breezes from the garden of the Supreme Concourse, and become so enkindled as to consume the world of existence with the fire of the love of the Lord of Bounty.

order.why: Hear the prayer for love and attraction.
Keep remembrance of the addressee within personal supplication.
Read the prayer joining this world’s love with the hope of beholding.
Hear the invocation of the One who kindles love.
shortened: By Thy glory, O Thou Who enkindleth the fire of love in the hearts of them that love Thee and causeth the flames to rage throughout all regions!

order.why: Consider the different effects of the Name and the prayer for assistance.
Read the prayer for a door in every atom leading to reunion.
Keep the remembrance from the Tree of Love with its existing omission.
Consider remembrance as warmth that does not grow cold.
Close the linked readings with the invitation to be illumined by the lamp.
Read the supplied John of the Cross passage as a distinct account of painful purification and the soul’s perceived smallness.

questions: How does the opening image of fire as a rose garden and living water change what we expect love to do?
What do the readings identify as the veils or desires to be consumed, and what qualities emerge in their place?
How might patience, wisdom, and forbearance give direction to intense spiritual feeling?
How does the Song of Songs’ unquenchable love illuminate this imagery while retaining the poem’s human relationship?
What do the passages on friendship, correspondence, and service suggest about sharing warmth with other people?
How can we read the language of longing, suffering, and sacrifice with care for both its spiritual meaning and the people whose experiences it recalls?

references.label: 1 · Song of Songs 8:6–7 · Love and unquenchable flame
references.note: Read the King James Version’s image of a seal, a vehement flame, and waters unable to extinguish love. Compare the force and endurance of this language with the compilation’s fire of divine love. Preserve the poem’s voice of human lovers while asking how its imagery opens possibilities for spiritual reflection.

subjects.displayTitle: Teaching and confirmation: effort, humility, and unseen help
subjects.introduction: A gnat into an eagle, a drop into rivers and seas, an atom into suns: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá prays in these terms for anyone who feels too small to share their faith, and promises as much to the feeblest soul who takes up a teacher’s qualities. The promise comes with conditions. Bahá’u’lláh tells the one whose listener turns away to turn away likewise and trust in God; ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asks for wisdom, meaning not silence but tolerance, patience and goodly deeds; and a teacher’s work ends the instant he credits a changed heart to himself, for it is the Spirit that confirms. Paul said much the same of planting and watering, with growth belonging to God alone [1]. What remains is effort offered without ownership, and the discovery that the teacher learns more than the pupil, that eloquence comes unbidden, and that slow fruitage is not failure. The road continues into divine grace and confirmation, into the spiritual capacity that teaching itself develops, and into the high station Bahá’u’lláh reserves for those who carry His word from place to place.
subjects.arc: Begin with courage for the apparently weak, establish the ethics of teaching, follow prayer and active learning into communal service, and close with supplied readings on humility and patient effort.

order.why: Open with the prayer transforming a gnat, drop, and atom into images of capacity.
shortened: How can I succeed unless Thou assist me with the breath of the Holy Spirit, help me to triumph by the hosts of Thy glorious kingdom, and shower upon me Thy confirmations, which alone can change a gnat into an eagle, a drop of water into rivers and seas, and an atom into lights and suns?

order.why: Read encouragement alongside the qualities and respect associated with teachers.
Establish the instruction to respect a listener who turns away.
shortened: Deliver the Cause of thy Lord to all who are in the heavens and on earth. If thou findest one who turneth unto it, reveal unto him the pearls of the wisdom of God, thy Lord, which the Spirit hath cast upon thee, and be of them that turn. And if thou findest one who turneth away, turn thou away from him and put thy trust in God, thy Lord and the Lord of all worlds.

order.why: Keep the call to teach together with caution and prudence.
shortened: Whosoever and whatsoever meeting becometh a hindrance to the diffusion of the Light of Faith, let the loved ones give them counsel and say: "Of all the gifts of God the greatest is the gift of Teaching. It draweth unto us the Grace of God and is our first obligation. Of such a gift how can we deprive ourselves? Nay, our lives, our goods, our comforts, our rest, we offer them all as a sacrifice for the Abha Beauty and teach the Cause of God." Caution and prudence, however, must be observed even as recorded in the Book. The veil must in no wise be suddenly rent asunder.

order.why: Make purity of intention and freedom from selfish motives central.
Read wisdom through tolerance, love, patience, character, and deeds.
shortened: Furthermore, the teaching work should under all conditions be actively pursued by the believers because divine confirmations are dependent upon it. Should a Baha'i refrain from being fully, vigorously and wholeheartedly involved in the teaching work he will undoubtedly be deprived of the blessings of the Abha Kingdom. Even so, this activity should be tempered with wisdom---not that wisdom which requireth one to be silent and forgetful of such an obligation, but rather that which requireth one to display divine tolerance, love, kindness, patience, a goodly character, and holy deeds.

order.why: Consider unity and the abandonment of prejudice as purposes of service.
Read the reported counsel to look beyond personal weakness toward love.
shortened: One must never consider one's own feebleness, it is the strength of the Holy Spirit of Love, which gives the power to teach.

order.why: Consider the reported relationship between receiving education and offering it.
shortened: He who is educated by the Divine Spirit can, in his time, lead others to receive the same Spirit.

order.why: Read guidance of others as a setting for one’s own opened understanding.
shortened: The doors of knowledge are opened before him, his eyes become seeing and he is assisted with the breaths of the Holy Spirit. He is guided himself and becomes the cause of guidance of others.
Moreover, everything is limited except the bounty of God and this bounty descends upon man through teaching the Cause of God; then divine inspiration will assist him.

order.why: Keep the reported teacher’s learning beside the pupil’s learning.
Consider the teacher as a bird exhilarated by its own singing.
shortened: When the friends do not endeavor to spread the message, they fail to remember God befittingly, and will not witness the tokens of assistance and confirmation from the Abha Kingdom nor comprehend the divine mysteries. However, when the tongue of the teacher is engaged in teaching, he will naturally himself be stimulated, will become a magnet attracting the divine aid and bounty of the Kingdom, and will be like unto the bird at the hour of dawn, which itself becometh exhilarated by its own singing, its warbling and its melody....

order.why: Read the reported distinction between divine confirmation and a fund of facts.
shortened: Conveying the Message (or teaching) is accomplished to-day by the Confirmation of the Holy Spirit, and not by any fund of knowledge or by the possession of facts.

order.why: Keep careful reading and pondering within the reported counsel.
Consider inspiration as connected with the condition described by the source.
shortened: Once the Lord hath enabled thee to attain this condition, be thou assured that He will inspire thee with words of truth, and will cause thee to speak through the breathings of the Holy Spirit.

order.why: Read the hope that teachers become physicians addressing the world’s afflictions.
shortened: It is my hope that the breaths of the Holy Spirit will so be breathed into your hearts that your tongues will disclose the mysteries, and set forth and expound the inner meanings of the Holy Books; that the friends will become physicians, and will, through the potent medicine of the heavenly Teachings, heal the long-standing diseases that afflict the body of this world; that they will make the blind to see, the deaf to hear, the dead to come alive; that they will awaken those who are sound asleep.

order.why: Follow the concrete sequence of prayer, speech, and courage.
shortened: Speak, therefore; speak out with great courage at every meeting. When you are about to begin your address, turn first to Bahá’u’lláh and ask for the confirmations of the Holy Spirit, then open your lips and say whatever is suggested to your heart; this, however, with the utmost courage, dignity and conviction.

order.why: Read detachment before speaking.
shortened: O thou maid-servant of God! Whenever thou art intending to deliver a speech, turn thy face toward the kingdom of ABHA and, with a heart detached, begin to talk. The breaths of the Holy Spirit will assist thee.

order.why: Keep asking for spiritual bestowals joined to action.
shortened: Turn thy face toward the Kingdom of God, ask for the bestowals of the Holy Spirit, speak, and the confirmations of the Spirit will come.

order.why: Retain the reported personal assurance to Juliet in its own setting.
Keep the reported hope for minds stirred and hearts set aglow.
shortened: I hope you will fill the minds with the tumult and acclamation of the kingdom, set aglow the hearts with the fire of reality and spread far and wide the good news of the King of eternal life..."

order.why: Read testimony to what one has witnessed or heard, offered with joy.
shortened: Speak openly of all the signs of the Kingdom of God that ye have witnessed with your own eyes and share with the utmost happiness and exultation all that ye have heard of the divine teachings. I fervently supplicate God to bring assurance to your souls and to raise you up with such steadfastness that each of you may withstand an entire nation. May you become so inebriated with the wine of the love of God that ye may cause your hearers to dance with blissful rapture to the song and melody of the love of God.

order.why: Consider the pure heart and love accompanying the act of teaching.
shortened: If one arise to promote the Word of God with a pure heart, overflowing with the love of God and severed from the world, the Lord of Hosts will assist him with such a power as will penetrate the core of the existent beings.

order.why: Read the reported connection between humility and renewed dedication.
shortened: Those souls who have become subservient to the will of God as manifested in the life and teachings of Baha'u'llah must know of a certainty that they attract unto themselves heavenly confirmation and assistance. Now, existence upon the Sacred Threshold is a magnet whereby aid is attracted. The more the believers humble themselves at the Divine Threshold, the more powerful and universal will be the descent of the Holy Spirit of new dedication upon them. The more they strive to teach souls the greater will be their power of sanctification and attraction.

order.why: Consider the source’s contrasting images of receptivity without turning them into judgments about particular listeners.
Read the reported green earth as an image of confirmation known by its fruits.
shortened: When a Cause is confirmed it is evident and manifest from its signs. For example we say this earth is confirmed. Why? Because as the result of the downpour of rain and the shining of the sun it is covered with green plants and flowers.

order.why: Follow the tree from planting through fruit offered to the world.
shortened: This tree that is planted in the realm of possibility will reach to the branches of the Supreme Concourse, becoming full of leaves and blossoms, laden with fruits, and these fruits will be scattered throughout the world of existence. One righteous deed becomes the cause of abundant bounty.

order.why: Consider the promise of future harvests from a pure seed.
shortened: This pure seed that thou hast sown shall yield many, many harvests and will produce most great results in the future.

order.why: Read fertile soil and sacrificial effort together.
Keep the reported seed-sowing analogy in its seasonal setting.
shortened: Now is the time when no confirmations descend except for seed sowing. Whosoever sows seeds at this time is confirmed -- that is, whosoever teaches is confirmed. That means that whosoever sows the seeds of faith in the fertile soil of hearts, such a one is confirmed.

order.why: Read the reported invitation to arise without waiting for a personal command.
Keep sowing and reaping within the source’s future horizon.
shortened: Soon we shall witness the fruits of this bestowal and bounty in the Most Glorious Kingdom, and whatever has been sown shall be reaped.

order.why: Consider the promised increase in assistance through advance in service.
shortened: The more you advance in this important matter, the more divine confirmations and heavenly successes will become manifest and evident, to such a degree that you yourselves will be astonished. This is an assured matter and an unfailing promise.

order.why: Read the urgency of time and the magnet of teaching.
Connects divine confirmations with actively arising to teach.
Keep life for souls beside the image of attracting invisible aid.
shortened: In short: Teaching the Cause of God is the cause of life to the souls and a magnet for attracting Divine, Invisible aid.

order.why: Read the lamp and glass as an image of bounty expressed through teaching.
Consider opened knowledge, awakened attention, and guidance as teaching’s work.
shortened: If thou seekest confirmation from all directions, open thy tongue to spread the Divine proofs, make seeing the sightless eyes, rend asunder the veil of heedlessness from the heedless, awaken those who sleep, and open the gates of knowledge before the faces of the ignorant. Then shalt thou witness the assistance of the hosts of the Supreme Concourse and behold the aid and victory of the angels of the Most Glorious Kingdom.

order.why: Read the concise call to focus effort and witness new favors.
Keep the source’s strong connection between teaching and confirmation.
Read its closely related claim about the exceptional station of teaching.
shortened: No endeavor receives confirmations like teaching, and no soul will succeed except the teacher.

order.why: Retain the reported promise of eloquence through sustained teaching.
shortened: You will be confirmed; a great bounty will descend upon you. You will become eloquent. Your tongue will be loosed. Teach, always teach. The confirmations of the Holy Spirit will descend upon those who teach constantly.

order.why: Consider arising to teach as itself a bounty.
shortened: Therefore, blessed are those souls who arise to teach the Cause of God. By thy life, this is indeed a great bounty!

order.why: Read service from afar described through the station of pilgrimage.
shortened: Today teaching the Cause of God is the greatest of all affairs and whoever arises for it will receive the fragrant breezes of the Holy Shrine from afar and attain the station of a pilgrim. Divine confirmations will encompass them and heavenly assistance will be unveiled.

order.why: Consider nearness and mercy as the meaning of this service.
shortened: This service is highly acceptable in the court of the One and is the cause of drawing near to the Worshipped One. This is the station of those drawn nigh, this is following the Manifest Light, and this is a mercy to all the worlds.

order.why: Read the contrast between a fragile web and an enduring foundation.
shortened: Surely those souls who are aware of this hidden secret will dedicate their breath to this foundation and basis, and the sweetness of this gift will so sweeten their palate that its sweetness will endure in the eternal world. This was the ultimate aim and desire of the longtime friends. Engaging in other matters is like building a house from spider's web, but this glorious purpose is like an eternal lofty palace and a divine foundation and gift of both worlds.

order.why: Keep the Tablet of the Divine Plan’s account of enduring sovereignty in its own voice.
shortened: Should you be aided to render such a service, rest ye assured that your heads shall be crowned with the diadem of everlasting sovereignty, and at the threshold of oneness you will become the favored and accepted servants.

order.why: Read the particular Canadian and Greenland setting of the call.
shortened: Likewise in the provinces of Canada, such as Newfoundland, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Quebec, Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Alberta, British Columbia, Ungava, Keewatin, Mackenzie, Yukon, and the Franklin Islands in the Arctic Circle--the believers of God must become self-sacrificing and like unto the candles of guidance become ignited in the provinces of Canada. Should they show forth such a magnanimity, it is assured that they will obtain universal divine confirmations, the heavenly cohorts will reinforce them uninterruptedly, and a most great victory will be obtained.

order.why: Keep the martial imagery within the Tablet’s spiritual mission and luminous hearts.
shortened: These souls are the armies of God and the conquerors of the East and the West. Should one of them turn his face toward some direction and summon the people to the Kingdom of God, all the ideal forces and lordly confirmations will rush to his support and reinforcement.

O ye kind friends! Uplift your magnanimity and soar high toward the apex of heaven so that your blessed hearts may become illumined more and more, day by day, through the rays of the Sun of Reality, that is, His Holiness Baha'u'llah; at every moment the spirits may obtain a new life, and the darkness of the world of nature may be entirely dispelled; thus you may become incarnate light and personified spirit, become entirely unaware of the sordid matters of this world and in touch with the affairs of the divine world.

order.why: Read the explicit struggle against ignorance through knowledge and guidance.
shortened: O ye servants of the Sacred Threshold! The triumphant hosts of the Celestial Concourse, arrayed and marshalled in the Realms above, stand ready and expectant to assist and assure victory to that valiant horseman who with confidence spurs on his charger into the arena of service. Well is it with that fearless warrior, who armed with the power of true Knowledge, hastens unto the field, disperses the armies of ignorance, and scatters the hosts of error, who holds aloft the Standard of Divine Guidance, and sounds the Clarion of Victory.

order.why: Consider the keys that open cities of hearts.
shortened: This is easily proven, and the hosts of the Abha Kingdom in the Supreme Concourse have arranged their ranks and await the charging forth of souls in this field, so they may confirm and grant victory and open the cities of hearts with the keys of the Most Great Name.

order.why: Read steadfast effort directed toward peace, love, and unity.
Keep service to humanity and universal peace as the reported aims of assistance.
shortened: Now you should pray for them and supplicate confirmation and assistance for them that they may be able to promote the Word of God and be favored with the privilege of serving the world of humanity, that they may help to establish universal peace and lay the foundation of the oneness of the world of humanity.

order.why: Read the reported image of teachers grasping one another’s hands.
shortened: The believers must arise in perfect unity in teaching the Cause of God and grasping each other's hands be engaged in the diffusion of the fragrances of God, and know of a certainty that the confirmations of His Holiness Baha'u'llah shall descend upon them.

order.why: Bring committee service into the account of confirmation.
shortened: I was pleased to know, also, that you have organized a committee for correspondence with all part of the world, and another committee to each the Truth to the youths. Wonderful confirmation and complete assistance is destined for all the members of these various committees.

order.why: Read the Nineteen Day gathering as nourishment for wider service.
shortened: Thou didst write of the Nineteen Day festivity, and this rejoiced my heart. These gatherings cause the divine table to descend from Heaven, and draw down the confirmations of the All-Merciful. My hope is that the breathings of the Holy Spirit will be wafted over them, and that each one present shall, in great assemblies, with an eloquent tongue and a heart flooded with the love of God, set himself to acclaiming the rise of the Sun of Truth, the dawn of the Day-Star that lighteth all the World....

order.why: Consider assemblies as settings for light and spiritual attraction.
shortened: By God, the True One, verily, the Sun of Truth will cast forth its lights in your assemblies and will make you shining lamps, glittering stars, brilliant signs, and as souls attracted to the Holy Spirit. This is the great prosperity! This is the manifest light!

order.why: Read a journey through the harmony and renewed enthusiasm it produced.
Keep the particular news of service in Japan.
shortened: Both letters brought joy to hearts, for the words of each were an eloquent tongue in the love of God and told of the attraction of the heart to the breaths of the Holy Spirit.
Praise be to God that you have succeeded in raising the Word of God in Japan.

order.why: Read the dated letter’s joy at services and steadfastness.
shortened: O thou who art attracted by the breaths of the Holy Spirit!

Your detailed letter dated February 9, 1914 was received and its contents brought joy and delight, for it indicated the manifestation of the power of God's Cause in that land and the outstanding services of those firm in the Covenant and Testament.

order.why: Retain the reported happiness at news of spiritual progress in America.
Read the reported encounter with a small teacher whose spiritual children are tall.
Consider the reported peace and joy found in awakening love.
shortened: To awaken spiritual love in others is to attain peace and joy for yourself.

order.why: Keep the reported connection among happiness, confirmation, and illumination.
Read the Hidden Words’ relation between remembrance here and remembrance above.
Consider the reciprocal language of aiding and remembering.
Read turning toward God and merciful remembrance together.
Hear the promise of aid after the setting of the Manifestation’s outward presence.
shortened: Be not dismayed, O peoples of the world, when the day-star of My beauty is set, and the heaven of My tabernacle is concealed from your eyes. Arise to further My Cause, and to exalt My Word amongst men. We are with you at all times, and shall strengthen you through the power of truth.

order.why: Keep the reported recollection of help during the Western journey.
Read the acknowledgment of promises fulfilled through protection and widened hearts.
shortened: Praise be to God, the Ancient Beauty - may my spirit be a sacrifice for His promise - fulfilled all that He promised. He made the path smooth, turned the rocky ground into a level highway, spread the carpet of security and safety, and opened the way of justice and benevolence. He opened the gates of triumph and expanded confined hearts. He sent forth the hosts of the Abha Kingdom and dispatched the army of the Supreme Concourse. The waves of His confirmations arrived successively like ocean billows, and the ranks of the angels of divine success were arrayed.

order.why: Consider the source’s gratitude for successive confirmations.
Read accepted service and repeated assistance in a personal address.
Keep the brief thanksgiving for becoming a cause of guidance.
Read gratitude for aid from the Concourse on high.
shortened: Praise be to God, the hosts of the Supreme Concourse secure the victory and the power of the Kingdom is ready to assist and to support. Should ye at every instant unloosen the tongue in thanksgiving and gratitude, ye would not be able to discharge yourselves of the obligation of gratitude for these bestowals.

order.why: Keep the promise of spiritual assistance concise and direct.
shortened: The Blessed Beauty, in unmistakable language, hath made this promise in His Book: "We behold you from Our realm of glory, and shall aid whosoever will arise for the triumph of Our Cause with the hosts of the Concourse on high and a company of Our favored angels."

order.why: Read the varied images of inspiration, fragrance, life, and salvation.
shortened: He will come to your aid with invisible hosts, and support you with armies of inspiration from the Concourse above; He will send unto you sweet perfumes from the highest Paradise, and waft over you the pure breathings that blow from the rose gardens of the Company on high. He will breathe into your hearts the spirit of life, cause you to enter the Ark of salvation, and reveal unto you His clear tokens and signs. Verily is this abounding grace. Verily is this the victory that none can deny.

order.why: Consider spring rain as an image of grace supporting a heavenly purpose.
Keep the concise magnet image tied to a particular purpose.
Read the observation about those who arise to serve.
shortened: Consider how every soul who has arisen to serve the Word of God will be confirmed with the heavenly Cohorts.

order.why: Keep the prayer for protection and strength with consecration to work.
shortened: All those who consecrate themselves to this work are accompanied by divine protection.
I pray that thou mayest be aided and strengthened.

order.why: Retain the personal reported reassurance to Isabel Fraser.
shortened: Rest thou assured that I will be with you and you will be enabled to render great services. Let thy heart be at ease and have no fear.

order.why: Read the personal promise to a handmaiden in its particular address.
shortened: Rest thou assured that thou wilt find such a confirmation that thou wilt become the envy of all the women of the world.

order.why: Consider becoming an example of spiritual attainment.
shortened: Verily He will make thee a manifest example and an evident proof for the attainment of His Kingdom in this glorious century.

order.why: Read the prayer for guidance extending from one’s native land to others.
Keep the prayer for a distant lamp of guidance with its preserved omission.
shortened: The seekers flowed toward him and the thirsty ones hastened to drink from the water of his utterance.

O my God! Help him by the hosts of the approximate angels, assist him by the cohorts of the Supreme Concourse amid Thy creatures, make him a lamp of guidance in that distant part of the earth and a luminary shining and sparkling from the dawning-place of faithfulness, in order that he may serve Thy holy threshold, falling prostrate upon the ground thanking and praising for Thy bounty, liberality and gifts to him; girding up his loins of endeavor in Thy service and becoming reinforced and empowered in Thy adoration!

order.why: Consider a task described through enduring light and the removal of veils.
Read the promised widening of love in the letter’s exuberant imagery.
shortened: O thou who warmest thyself by the fire of the love of God, spreading from the Tree of the Covenant! Let thy soul be at ease and thy heart in peace concerning the perfect success and progress which the pen is not able to express, for in a short time thou shalt see the flag of the Kingdom waving in those far and wide regions, and the lights of the Truth shining brilliantly in its dawn above those horizons, and thou shalt know that thou art the center of the circle of the love of God, the axis around which souls revolve in their way and supplication to God.

order.why: Keep the hope of results within the Abha Kingdom.
shortened: I hope that through the grace and bounty of the Lord you will attain comprehensive results and witness the unlimited rewards of this service in the Abha Kingdom.

order.why: Consider the promised future recognition of care and mercy.
shortened: By the Ancient Beauty! - may my life be a sacrifice for His loved ones - Were the friends to realize what a glorious sovereignty the Lord hath destined for them in His Kingdom, surely they would be filled with ecstasy, would behold themselves crowned with immortal glory and carried away with transports of delight. Erelong it shall be made manifest how brilliantly the light of His bountiful care and mercy hath shone upon His loved ones, and what a turbulent ocean hath been stirred in their hearts! Then will they clamour and exclaim: Happy are we; let all the world rejoice!

order.why: Read the source’s insistence that the station of the steadfast exceeds description.
Keep the reported statement about parents’ forgiveness attributed to its recollection.
Read the Noah allusion and spiritual spring as images of awakened knowledge.
Consider human powers assisted in inviting others.
shortened: O bondswoman of God! The human spirit possesseth wondrous powers, but it should be reinforced by the Holy Spirit. What thou hearest other than this is pure imagination. If, however, it be assisted by the bounty of the Holy Spirit, then will its strength be a thing to marvel at. Then will that human spirit uncover realities, and unravel mysteries. Turn thy heart fully to the Holy Spirit, and invite others to do the same; then shall ye witness wonderful results.

order.why: Keep courage joined to love and steadfastness.
shortened:
The source of courage and power is the promotion of
the Word of God, and steadfastness in His Love.

order.why: Read trust amid fear of worldly power.
Consider reliance within the race-course image.
shortened: If thou art of the people of this field (race-course) let loose the reins and rely upon the Merciful, and He will indeed assist thee with the hosts of the unseen at all times.

order.why: Retain the reported call to extraordinary effort and divine help.
shortened: You must arise with superhuman strength to spread the teachings for the Cause is GREAT; and whosoever shall arise in this Day to TEACH, know that he will be assisted by the Divine Concourse.

order.why: Read the departing pilgrims’ reported assurance and blessing.
Keep the reported vision of white-plumaged birds in its testimonial voice.
shortened: When I entered a convention or a meeting I saw with my own eyes the confirmations of the Holy Spirit hovering like white-plumaged birds over my head and the Kingdom of existence with all its mighty forces coming to my assistance.

order.why: Close these devotional images with the prayer’s sea, shore, and fire.
Gather the reported many fruits of teaching before the supplied readings.
Open the supplied readings with the distinction between reed and life-giving water.
Read capacity developing through teaching while the Holy Spirit confirms.
Consider dedicated service without claiming ownership of another’s quickening.
Read the Baha’i life as the setting for spiritual influence.
Keep the warning against personal credit beside encouragement beyond frailty.
shortened: Do you think it is the teachers who make converts and change human hearts? No, surely not. They are only pure souls who take the first step, and then let the spirit of Baha'u'llah move them and make use of them. If any one of them should even for a second consider his achievements as due to his own capacities, his work is ended and his fall starts.

Stop being conscious of your frailties, therefore; have a perfect reliance upon God; let your heart burn with the desire to serve His mission and proclaim His call; and you will observe how eloquence and the power to change human hearts will come as a matter of course.

order.why: Read purification as the teacher’s continuing prayer.
shortened: It is the Holy Spirit that confirms. It is the Holy Spirit that gives new life. The constant prayer of the teacher should be that he may be purified, so the Holy Spirit may cause him to say or do something to affect the heart of the student.

order.why: Consider self-forgetfulness and service through the image of an instrument.
Read the counsel to look beyond one’s shortcomings.
Keep patience with slow fruitage as an essential qualification of success.
shortened: Do not feel discouraged if your labours do not always yield an abundant fruitage. For a quick and rapidly-won success is not always the best and the most lasting. The harder you strive to attain your goal, the greater will be the confirmations of Baha'u'llah, and the more certain you can feel to attain success. Be cheerful, therefore, and exert yourself with full faith and confidence.

order.why: Read perseverance and confidence amid obstacles.
Consider the daily effort and sacrifice associated with untapped strength.
Read the supplied account of effort, eloquence, and invisible assistance.
Preserve the imported wording and trailing fragment for source review.
Read the supplied promise of strength in speaking truth.
Consider departure from home and the fire of love in the supplied Gleanings passage.
Read the supplied promise of assistance from the realm of glory.
Consider help described as awaiting devoted action.
Keep the related martial image attached to spiritual teaching.
Read the metaphor of descending torrents and arising to serve.
Retain the letter’s emphasis on teaching in its stated historical moment.
Read the supplied assurance amid opposition in its devotional voice.
Keep the leaven image and its demanding relation between gift and responsibility.
Close with the extended supplied collection joining holy conduct, service, travel, remembrance, and perseverance.
shortened: "Say: O servants! The triumph of this Cause hath depended, and will continue to depend, upon the appearance of holy souls, upon the showing forth of goodly deeds, and the revelation of words of consummate wisdom."         "Center your energies in the propagation of the Faith of God. Whoso is worthy of so high a calling, let him arise and promote it. Whoso is unable, it is his duty to appoint him who will, in his stead, proclaim this Revelation, whose power hath caused the foundations of the mightiest structures to quake, every mountain to be crushed into dust, and every soul to be dumbfounded."

"Blessed is the spot, and the house, and the place, and the city, and the heart, and the mountain, and the refuge, and the cave, and the valley, and the land, and the sea, and the island, and the meadow where mention of God hath been made, and His praise glorified."         "The movement itself from place to place, when undertaken for the sake of God, hath always exerted, and can now exert, its influence in the world. In the Books of old the station of them that have voyaged far and near in order to guide the servants of God hath been set forth and written down."

questions: How do the images of the gnat, eagle, reed, and flowing water change our understanding of spiritual capacity?
How can confidence in divine assistance coexist with humility about our influence on another person?
What do the passages on tolerance, patience, and a listener who turns away suggest about the ethics of sharing faith?
How does Paul’s planting and watering comparison illuminate the relationship between effort, cooperation, and growth?
What forms of learning and transformation might occur in the teacher, and how might these be recognized?
How could service be assessed through its contribution to unity and peace when immediate results are small or difficult to see?
